name: pose-bench
description: Throwaway benchmark for docs/research/stack-swot.md. Not part of the app.

scripts.fetch-assets: mkdir -p models && for m in lite full heavy; do curl -sSL -o models/pose_landmarker_$m.task https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/pose_landmarker/pose_landmarker_$m/float16/latest/pose_landmarker_$m.task; done && curl -sSL -o pose.jpg https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-assets/pose.jpg
scripts.make-clip: ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -loop 1 -framerate 240 -t 5 -i pose.jpg -vf "scale=2400:1600,crop=1920:1080:'200+100*t':'200+40*sin(2*PI*t)',noise=alls=12:allf=t,format=yuv420p" -c:v libx264 -preset veryfast -b:v 64M -maxrate 64M -bufsize 64M -r 240 -g 240 -movflags +faststart clip240.mp4
